title: A BRIEF GUIDE TO DESIGNING AND EVALUATING HUMAN-CENTERED INTERACTIVE MACHINE LEARNING
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper is a guide for designing and evaluating IML systems and does not present a specific benchmark.
findings: This paper is a methodological guide for human-centered interactive machine learning and does not contain any analysis, benchmarks, or findings related to religion or faith.
